description: Update a Goal — change its name, due date, description, color, and add/remove owners. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated Goal.

add_owners.description: User ids to add to the Goal's owners.

color.description: New accent color as a hex string.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep current.

due_date.description: New due date (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms). Omit to keep current.

goal_id.description: ID of the Goal to update.

name.description: New name. Omit to keep the current name.

rem_owners.description: User ids to remove from the Goal's owners.

name: update_goal
